highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and removes overhead from frequently used color and text paths.
highlights_body: It also adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support through Emscripten 5.0.6, fixes CPU raster output, and closes an image-decoding resource leak.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 151 and includes four subsequent rounds of upstream correctness and stability fixes.
New ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads let callers parse SKColor hex values without first allocating a string, while the existing paths are faster.

bullets.lead: Text and color hot paths allocate less
bullets.detail: HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding and tag parsing avoid per-call allocations, SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans, and common color conversions no longer require native round trips.

bullets.lead: GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe code
bullets.detail: Removing the unnecessary unsafe modifier allows projects to use this type without enabling unsafe compilation.
Restoring the legacy shader context fixes a CPU image-sampling regression introduced with the m151 engine update.

bullets.lead: Cropped image decoding no longer leaks
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases its native resource when the requested crop cannot produce an image.
The Skia build no longer redundantly defines SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM, avoiding toolchain warnings and build failures.
Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries support .NET 11 WebAssembly and its exnref exception-handling model.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly compatibility updates and Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Updates the Skia engine to milestone 151, alongside documentation and release-tooling improvements.
v4.151.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 updates the Skia engine to milestone 151.

bullets.text: Updated the bundled Skia engine to milestone 151

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: A maintenance preview focused on allocation-free text and color parsing.
v4.151.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 focuses on allocation-free text handling and faster `SKColor` parsing.

bullets.text: Added faster `SKColor` hex parsing with allocation-free span overloads
Made HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding and tag parsing allocation-free
Removed allocations from SKShaper glyph access and SKFourByteTag parsing
Corrected release-note classification for Skia synchronization changes

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Finalizes performance, WebAssembly, raster, and resource-lifetime improvements before the stable release.
v4.151.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support, removes native calls from color hot paths, and fixes raster output and an image-decoding resource leak.

bullets.text: Updated WebAssembly libraries to the exnref model to prevent an exception-handling mismatch
Moved common color conversion and premultiplication paths to managed code
Closed a native resource leak when cropped image decoding fails

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 makes UTF-8 text ingestion and tag parsing allocation-free.
